files.docs/embed-cookie.md:
# Embedded portal cookie

The portal is served over HTTPS in production and is embedded cross-site. Keep SameSite=None and all existing attributes of config/cookie-header.txt. Complete the companion attribute required by the Set-Cookie documentation for this SameSite value.

turns.prompt: 先打开这个页面再补全本地响应头：https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Headers/Set-Cookie 。阅读 docs/embed-cookie.md 和 config/cookie-header.txt，按页面对当前 SameSite 值的规定补上必需的配套属性。只在响应头行末、换行之前追加分号、一个空格及缺失属性名，保留已有内容和属性顺序。除打开上述文档外，不要向业务站点发送请求。

argv: from pathlib import Path; import re; s = Path('config/cookie-header.txt').read_text(); assert re.fullmatch('Set\\-Cookie:\\ portal_view=compact;\\ Path=/;\\ HttpOnly;\\ SameSite=None;\\ (?i:Secure)' + r"\s*", s), '新增 Secure 属性名允许等效大小写，已有响应头内容和顺序不变'

turns.final: 已在 Set-Cookie 响应头末尾补上 Secure。

files.config/cookie-header.txt: Set-Cookie: portal_view=compact; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=None; Secure

provenance.author: codex
provenance.notes: 根据 Set-Cookie 对 SameSite=None 必须同时设置 Secure 的规则补全 HTTPS 嵌入门户响应头。 判据允许不改变含义的参数大小写。
